name: Mauritius

fees.name: Tourist visa (applied in advance where required)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa prior to travel
fees.notes: Official Passport and Immigration Office: 'Visas and Extensions of stay are issued free of charge.'

fees.name: Visa on arrival (incl. medical visa on arrival)
fees.validity: medical visa granted on arrival for duration of treatment, max 6 months
fees.notes: No fee; all visas issued free of charge.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa prior to travel
fees.notes: Application page states 'Visa is free of cost'.

fees.name: All-in-One Travel Digital Form (pre-arrival travel form)
fees.notes: Mandatory pre-arrival digital form (not a visa); free of charge, QR code issued after submission.

free_visa_notes: Mauritius issues ALL visas and extensions of stay free of charge (official Passport and Immigration Office: 'Visas and Extensions of stay are issued free of charge'). Most nationalities (incl. USA, GBR, CAN, RUS, IND, CHN, EU) are visa-free or get a free entry stamp on arrival; a smaller set of nationalities must obtain a free visa in advance (processing up to 12 working days). No e-visa fee, no VFS/outsourced centres, no reciprocity fee schedule.
